## Functional assignment

The sequence is **pantothenate synthetase** (EC **6.3.2.1**), the enzyme that produces pantothenate (vitamin B5) from pantoate and β-alanine.

**Reaction:**

\[
(R)\text{-pantoate} + \beta\text{-alanine} + ATP
\rightarrow (R)\text{-pantothenate} + AMP + diphosphate + H^+
\]

The enzyme catalyzes this ATP-dependent condensation via a **pantoyl-adenylate intermediate**.

**Evidence:** The 285-aa query is an exact, full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt pantothenate synthetases Q04S98 and Q050C4. The reaction is mapped to Rhea **RHEA:10912**. This is a sequence-based functional assignment supported by curated annotations, not a direct assay of the supplied protein.
